_meta.purpose: Canonical author ratings for every Mastery proposal. One number, one source. Any proposal citing a rating reads it from here.

sources.deck: Author-proposal deck (Expert & Authority + AI for Founders sections)

rules: Ratings are the Avg Rating rollup; n is the # Ratings rollup. Not attendance.
Always publish n alongside any rating under 50.
Where the deck and the base disagree, the BASE wins and the discrepancy is recorded below.
Never cite a 'highest in base' claim without re-deriving it from the base.

deck_discrepancies_found.author: Chris Do
deck_discrepancies_found.note: Deck also claims 'highest single lesson score in Social Media Mastery'. FALSE — it ranks 6th. Sabrina Stocker 9.93, Domenic Ashburn 9.85, Vishen 9.81 and 9.79 all sit above it.

deck_discrepancies_found.author: Chris Do — Strategic Content Architecture
deck_discrepancies_found.note: Two different deliveries of the same title in two bases. Cite the base, not the title.

deck_discrepancies_found.author: Vykintas Glodenis / AIM labs
deck_discrepancies_found.deck_says: Implementation Labs 9.0–10.0 including a perfect 10 ('Build the App You Always Wished Existed': 10.0)
deck_discrepancies_found.base_says: Labs run 8.14–9.46, avg ≈9.2. That lab is 9.18 (n=83). No 10.0 exists; 9.87 is the capstone teach.
deck_discrepancies_found.note: Claim appears on the live AI Founders proposal page and in earlier drafts of the E&A proposal.

vishen_lakhiani.name: Vishen Lakhiani

verified.title: Unlocking New Revenue Streams with Innovation
Build Your Lead Magnet Funnel: From Click to Client
Vibe Coding to Build Your First Prototype
Own Your Audience: List Building & Email Lists
Building Businesses in the Age of AI (Opening Class)
Social Media Strategies To Produce Impactful Videos
Build Your First App with AI Vibe-Coding

vishen_lakhiani.reading: Bimodal, and the split matters for this curriculum. Content and webinar teaching rates 9.6-9.8. Direct-response mechanics — email lists, copy, upsells, funnels — rates 8.3-8.9, on large samples. The ladder and the email sequence are the two weakest topics in his rated history, and they are two of his eight teach weeks in the current design.

ajit_nawalkha.name: Ajit Nawalkha
ajit_nawalkha.role_ea: not currently in the E&A proposal — see reading

verified.title: Money Mastery for Coaches and Consultants
What to Build with AI (and What to Avoid)
Selling High Ticket Coaching and Consulting

ajit_nawalkha.reading: The most-tested instructor in any Mindvalley programme, and his strongest topics are this curriculum's spine: offers, product stacking, sales letters, launches, high-ticket selling, workshops. On the offer-and-ladder mechanics he rates roughly a full point above Vishen. Worth a deliberate decision rather than an omission.

chris_do.name: Chris Do

verified.title: From Viral to Valuable: Attention → Authority + Sales

chris_do.reading: Strong and consistent on the attention-to-authority topic, which is exactly this programme's bridge. Not the top score in SMM — that claim in the deck is wrong. Still not on the Expert & Authority speaker record.

sabrina_stocker.name: Sabrina Stocker
sabrina_stocker.reading: The highest-rated lesson in the entire Social Media Mastery base, and it is a live-build feedback session — the exact format the Thursday lab uses. This is the strongest lab-format evidence we hold on anyone. Currently listed only as a lab-lead alternate; the data argues for promoting her.

kwame_christian.name: Kwame Christian

verified.title: Build & Test Your Personal AI Operating System

kwame_christian.reading: Deck figures confirmed exactly. Three sessions, all 9.47+, healthy samples. The most reliable guest on this list.

john_lee.name: John Lee

verified.title: How to Make $1,000,000 From Social Media & AI (Without Being Famous)
From Followers to Freedom — Passive Income
Monetizing Your Brand — Visibility into High-Ticket

john_lee.reading: Three real sessions, 9.14-9.54. Ignore the three 5.00 n=1 rows in SMM — single-vote noise, not signal.

natalie_ellis.name: Natalie Ellis

verified.title: The Million Dollar Social Sales Funnel

natalie_ellis.reading: 9.16, not the 9.25 in the deck. One session only, and it is the lowest-rated author currently carrying a teach week in the E&A proposal. Below the 9.3 bar.

paul_mckenna.name: Paul McKenna
paul_mckenna.reading: Held within 0.01 across two cohorts. 2026 sample verified: n=79. Caution from SIM 2025: his off-cadence add-on session drew 23% attendance — the format, not the teacher, decides show-up (learnings L2).

lisa_nichols.name: Lisa Nichols

verified.title: The Evolution and Power of Story
Workshop | The Evolution and Power of Story

lisa_nichols.reading: Highest-rated SIM 2026 session to date, n=75. Her workshop version also ran (9.39, n=64) — one of the few S&I workshops with its own data.

alessio_pieroni.name: Alessio Pieroni
alessio_pieroni.reading: No Mindvalley cohort rating in any base. Evidence is commercial plus the accelerator segment. Now carries lab lead on 7 days plus the intensive build floor — the largest unrated exposure in the proposal.

akash_rupalia.name: Akash "Kash" Rupalia
akash_rupalia.reading: No Mindvalley cohort rating. Now carries lab lead on 5 days plus the intensive shoot floor.

domenic_ashburn.name: Domenic Ashburn

verified.title: Generate Any Image or Graphic Asset
Turn Ideas into Images with AI
AI Systems for Content Velocity & Testing

domenic_ashburn.reading: Deep bench strength across SMM and AIM — huge samples (n up to 229), consistently 9.4+. Nobody has proposed him for either Mastery.

daniel_priestley.name: Daniel Priestley

verified.title: Find, Understand, and Win Your Best Customers

daniel_priestley.reading: All twelve deck figures confirmed against the base. Average 9.55, floor 9.22. The deck's Priestley data is accurate — the errors are elsewhere.

noelle_russell.name: Noelle Russell
noelle_russell.reading: Confirmed. Highest single lesson in the EM base.

vykintas_glodenis.name: Vykintas Glodenis

verified.title: Implementation Lab: Build the App You Always Wished Existed

vykintas_glodenis.reading: Excellent, but the AI Founders page inflates him: labs run 8.14–9.46 (avg ≈9.2), and NO perfect-10 lab exists — the 9.87 is his capstone teach. Strongest at integration; the capstone family (teach 9.87, Q&A 9.66, lab 9.46) is the best-rated cluster in the AIM base.
